text:
morgan: Heads up — main CI went red a few minutes after the merge of PR #3421 (merged by @sam). Failing job: integration/gpu-alloc (step 7). Error looks like `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` but only on 2/12 shards. Can someone take a look?
ci-bot: [CI] Build 18765 (main) status: FAILED — step integration/gpu-alloc (node-78). Logs: https://ci.redwood/18765 (see `job-18765-7` logs).
sam: on it. I didn't see this locally. Could be infra flake. @jen can you rerun step 7 for that build id?
jen: rerun queued: `/rerun build 18765 step integration/gpu-alloc` -> job 18765-7. Will post result.
ci-bot: [CI] Rerun started for job 18765-7 on node-102.
priya: quick FYI — node-102 had elevated memory pressure earlier; I filed a note. pinging @ci-ops in case it's related.
ci-ops: looking now. Node-78 had a kernel OOM yesterday and node-102 is on the same rack. Spinning up a fresh runner for retries and marking node-102 draining.
ci-bot: [CI] Rerun result: FAILED again — job 18765-7 (node-102). Log snippet: "malloc failed at kv_cache.cc:423".
alex: two failures on the same node after requeue -> likely infra. But if this blocks releases we should consider reverting the merge. @morgan do you want a revert PR?
morgan: not yet. @sam can you try a quick local repro on our GPU fleet? If you can reproduce it's probably a code regression (PR 3421 changed kv cache warm-up). If not, infra.
sam: starting a repro run on the internal cluster now. If I can repro I'll open a revert PR. ETA ~30m.
jen: kicked another rerun on a different rack to isolate infra: `/rerun build 18765-7 node-preferred=node-115`.
ci-bot: [CI] Rerun started for job 18765-7 on node-115.
ci-bot: [CI] Rerun result: PASSED on node-115. All steps green -> build 18765 marked SUCCESS.
sam: ok that points to a flaky/quarantined node (node-102). I'll still run the local repro and add a small guard in kv cache init to be defensive on low-memory runners.
morgan: great. @ci-ops can you mark node-102 quarantined and add this to the infra incident log so we don't keep hitting it?
ci-ops: will do. Node-102 set to quarantined/drain, incident card created. :white_check_mark: 
jen: leaving a comment on PR 3421 referencing the CI flake and the infra action.
priya: thanks — closing loop once sam confirms local repro status. :eyes:
